title: Independent Technologist | Web, Automation & Game Development
intro: Welcome to my digital corner. I’m Ümit — a self-taught, intensely curious technologist, developer, translator, and digital investigator. I’ve been immersed in technology for 20 years; I chose a long, hands-on path: starting from the basics and progressing by developing my skills in software, HTML5, visual editing, music, and game design.
quote: "I didn’t wait for permission or a certificate to start learning. I just started." —Ümit
